findings.plain_english: Tests whether YES contracts in Mentions markets priced from $0.10 through $0.30 one day before close have a negative mean return when bought at the ask after fees.

findings.direction: positive means the one-hour price was more mispriced

method.fees: quadratic taker fee ceil-to-cent(0.07 × contracts × P × (1-P)); buys use the ask; compact chunks omit series fee metadata, so fee_multiplier=1 is assumed
method.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg over the latest discovery run per hypothesis, separately from confirmation runs
